name: appcoef
setup: x = (1:16)'; [c, l] = wavedec(x, 3, 'db2'); [~, ~, Lo_R, Hi_R] = wfilters('db2');
expr: A_def = appcoef(c, l, 'db2'); A_l1 = appcoef(c, l, 'db2', 1); A_l2 = appcoef(c, l, 'db2', 2); A_cust = appcoef(c, l, Lo_R, Hi_R); A_cust_l1 = appcoef(c, l, Lo_R, Hi_R, 1);
comment: Sig: A = appcoef(c, l, wname[, level]) or (c, l, LoR, HiR[, level]); optional 'Mode'/'mode' N-V (only 'sym' supported). 2026-05-08: cascades-fixed via wfilters Lo_D/Lo_R label-swap. Custom-filter form added in this commit.
